snippet.title: Version 1.5 of Infinity Nikki "Bubble Season" officially launches on April 28th!
snippet.description:
Version 1.5 of Infinity Nikki "Bubble Season" officially launches on April 28th!
Get ready for all-new gameplay, multiplayer adventures, the DIY Workshop, the mysterious Sea of Stars, brand-new areas, and so much more! Stylists, check it out and join in the fun! 🤝

♾️The official trailer for Version 1.5 [Bubble Season] is now live!
The Sea of Stars stretches endlessly, where past, present, and future converge.
The stars hold the truth—
Resonate with them, and receive their blessing...

——
Side by side, the world unfolds in beauty.
Infinity Nikki Version 1.5 "Bubble Season" launches globally on April 28th! (UTC-7)
➤ Download Now: https://infinitynikki.onelink.me/P6fe/mrxgprph
